Ui.Script:
local detailTiles = {} local zoneLabels = {} local enabled = { quests = true, services = true, dungeons = true } local controls = nil local active = false local currentZoom = 1
local function category(icon) if icon == 64 or icon == 65 then return "quests" end if icon == 70 then return "dungeons" end if icon and icon >= 66 and icon <= 69 then return "services" end return nil end
local function kind(icon) if icon == 64 then return "Available quest" end if icon == 65 then return "Quest ready to turn in" end if icon == 66 then return "Trainer" end if icon == 67 then return "Vendor" end if icon == 68 then return "Innkeeper" end if icon == 69 then return "Flight master" end if icon == 70 then return "Dungeon entrance" end return "Landmark" end
local function ensureControls() if controls then return end controls = CreateFrame("Frame", "BenillaMapNavigationControls", WorldMapFrame) controls:SetWidth(360) controls:SetHeight(28) controls:SetPoint("BOTTOMLEFT", WorldMapZoomFrame, "BOTTOMLEFT", 8, 6) controls:SetFrameLevel(WorldMapButton:GetFrameLevel() + 5) local keys = { "quests", "services", "dungeons" } local titles = { "Quests", "Services", "Dungeons" } for i = 1, 3 do local button = CreateFrame("Button", "BenillaMapFilter" .. i, controls, "UIPanelButtonTemplate") button:SetWidth(94) button:SetHeight(22) button:SetPoint("LEFT", controls, "LEFT", (i - 1) * 98, 0) button.key = keys[i] button.title = titles[i] button:SetText(titles[i] .. ": On") button:SetScript("OnClick", function() enabled[this.key] = not enabled[this.key] this:SetText(this.title .. (enabled[this.key] and ": On" or ": Off")) WorldMapTooltip:Hide() WorldMapFrame_Update() end) end end
local function updateMarks() local groups = {} local width, height = WorldMapButton:GetWidth(), WorldMapButton:GetHeight() for i = 1, GetNumMapLandmarks() do local poi = getglobal("WorldMapFramePOI" .. i) local name, description, icon, u, v = GetMapLandmarkInfo(i) if poi then poi.benillaGroup = nil if poi.benillaCount then poi.benillaCount:Hide() end if poi.benillaName then poi.benillaName:Hide() end local cat = category(icon) if cat and enabled[cat] then local group = nil -- A constant screen radius separates neighbouring NPCs naturally as -- the terrain zooms. Distinct marker types retain their own symbols. for j = 1, table.getn(groups) do local g = groups[j] local dx, dy = (u - g.u) * width, (v - g.v) * height if icon == g.icon and dx * dx + dy * dy < 18 * 18 then group = g break end end local row = { name = name, description = description, icon = icon } if group then table.insert(group.rows, row) poi:Hide() else group = { poi = poi, icon = icon, u = u, v = v, rows = { row } } table.insert(groups, group) poi:Show() end elseif cat then poi:Hide() end end end for i = 1, table.getn(groups) do local g = groups[i] local poi = g.poi poi.benillaGroup = g.rows local count = table.getn(g.rows) if count > 1 then if not poi.benillaCount then poi.benillaCount = poi:CreateFontString(nil, "OVERLAY", "GameFontNormalSmall") poi.benillaCount:SetPoint("BOTTOMRIGHT", poi, "BOTTOMRIGHT", 5, -4) end poi.benillaCount:SetText(count) poi.benillaCount:Show() elseif currentZoom >= 4 then if not poi.benillaName then poi.benillaName = poi:CreateFontString(nil, "OVERLAY", "GameFontNormalSmall") poi.benillaName:SetPoint("LEFT", poi, "RIGHT", 3, 0) end poi.benillaName:SetText(g.rows[1].name) -- Nearby labels must not cover other targets. Tooltips always retain names. local clear = true for j = 1, i - 1 do local other = groups[j] if math.abs((g.u - other.u) * width) < 150 and math.abs((g.v - other.v) * height) < 18 then clear = false end end if clear then poi.benillaName:Show() end end end end
function BenillaMapNavigation_Update(plate, canvas, zoom) active = canvas ~= nil currentZoom = zoom if not active then if controls then controls:Hide() end for i = 1, table.getn(zoneLabels) do zoneLabels[i]:Hide() end for i = 1, table.getn(detailTiles) do detailTiles[i]:Hide() end return end ensureControls() controls:Show() -- Detail is inside the geography plate, above its background and below its -- exploration covers. The closed-zone fog stays above both terrain layers. local alpha = math.max(0, math.min(1, (zoom - 2) / 2)) local count = 0 for row = 0, 13 do for col = 0, 19 do count = count + 1 local tile = detailTiles[count] if not tile then tile = plate:CreateTexture("BenillaMapTerrainDetail" .. count, "BORDER") tile:SetWidth(math.min(256, 5015 - col * 256)) tile:SetHeight(math.min(256, 3343 - row * 256)) tile:SetPoint("TOPLEFT", plate, "TOPLEFT", col * 256, -row * 256) tile:SetTexture("Interface\\Benilla\\map\\world-map-detail_" .. count) detailTiles[count] = tile end tile:SetAlpha(alpha) if alpha > 0 then tile:Show() else tile:Hide() end end end for i = 1, table.getn(canvas) do local entry = canvas[i] local label = zoneLabels[i] if not label then label = WorldMapButton:CreateFontString("BenillaMapZoneLabel" .. i, "OVERLAY", "GameFontNormalLarge") zoneLabels[i] = label end label:ClearAllPoints() label:SetPoint("CENTER", WorldMapButton, "TOPLEFT", (entry.left + entry.width / 2) * WorldMapButton:GetWidth(), -(entry.top + entry.height / 2) * WorldMapButton:GetHeight()) label:SetText(entry.name) label:SetTextColor(1, 0.86, 0.56) if zoom < 3 then label:Show() else label:Hide() end end updateMarks() end
local oldEnter = WorldMapPOI_OnEnter function WorldMapPOI_OnEnter() local rows = this.benillaGroup if not active or not rows or table.getn(rows) < 2 then return oldEnter() end WorldMapTooltip:SetOwner(this, "ANCHOR_RIGHT") WorldMapTooltip:SetText(table.getn(rows) .. " nearby locations") for i = 1, table.getn(rows) do local row = rows[i] WorldMapTooltip:AddLine(row.name .. " - " .. kind(row.icon), 1, 0.82, 0.3, 1) if row.description and row.description ~= "" then for line in string.gfind(row.description, "[^\n]+") do WorldMapTooltip:AddLine(line, 1, 1, 1, 1) end end end WorldMapTooltip:AddLine("Scroll to zoom in and separate locations.", 0.7, 0.7, 0.7, 1) WorldMapTooltip:Show() end
